address: 107 avenue de la République, Clermont-Ferrand, 63000, France
bio: The set menus, which are modern and shine the spotlight on local ingredients from the Massif Central, of this restaurant inside the Marcel Michelin rugby stadium, are named after the game's terminology (forward pass, grand slam and backhand spin). Designed in the spirit of a contemporary brasserie, the dining area commands a breathtaking view over the stadium and, from the terrace, over the Puys mountains....
